Explanation_Of_Crash_Positions_List: Set Use_Random_Generated_Crash_Sites to 1 to enable or 0 to disable ( Or true/false ). If enabled, helicopter crash sites will be randomly generated instead of using the following list of crash sites. Set Use_World_Generated_Locations to 1 to enable or 0 to disable ( Or true/false ). If enabled, locations will be choosen at random using the WorldGeneratedLocations.json. The following list is of all the possible helicopter crash site positions.
Explanation_Of_Missile_Launcher_Position: The following missile launchers will be used if valid coordinates are added. You are also able to set the radius, rate of fire by seconds and targets of each missile launcher separately. For Target_Types: 1 = Dynamic Crash helicopters, 2 = CH-47 Transport, 4 = CH-47 Supplydrop, 8 = player piloted helicopters, 16 = AH-64 Event helicopter. You can set multiple targets by adding together each types # value. For example 31 = all types because 1 + 2 + 4 + 8 + 16 = 31
